summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of its share buy-back programme, which acquired 462,683,139 own shares (3.08% of share capital) for EUR 5,030 million. The programme terminated upon reaching the maximum investment. The shares will be cancelled via a capital reduction of EUR 231,341,569.50, reducing share capital to EUR 7,278,241,400.50. The reduction, approved by shareholders on 27 March 2026 and authorized by the ECB on 2 February 2026, will increase profit per share without returning contributions. Creditors' objection rights are waived under Spanish law, and bondholder consent is not required. Watch for the execution of the capital reduction and share delisting.
